instruction: Fix the package's public API in `codec/__init__.py` so `codec.byte_count` actually counts bytes. `__init__` currently aliases `byte_count` to `char_count`, so `codec.byte_count('中')` returns 1 instead of 3.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec/__init__.py b/codec/__init__.py
--- a/codec/__init__.py
+++ b/codec/__init__.py
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@
 """
 
 from codec.binary import base64_decode, base64_encode, hex_decode, hex_encode
-from codec.text import char_count, char_count as byte_count, normalize
+from codec.text import byte_count, char_count, normalize
 from codec.url import encode_query, url_decode, url_encode
 
 __all__ = [
